description: This file contains a JUnit test class for the ConceptMapTypeEditor, which is a property editor in the OpenMRS project. It extends a base test class and uses Spring's dependency injection to obtain the ConceptService, then tests the behavior related to ConceptMapType objects.

classes.name: ConceptMapTypeEditorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the ConceptMapTypeEditor, testing its capability to correctly instantiate and retrieve ConceptMapType instances.

methods.name: getNewEditor
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the ConceptMapTypeEditor used in tests.

methods.name: getExistingObject
methods.description: Retrieves an existing ConceptMapType object using the conceptService and predefined ID.
